query: SELECT r.name, p.name, rp.effect FROM roles r LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=r.id LEFT JOIN permissions p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE r.id = ANY($1) ORDER BY r.name, p.name
